Recorded claim:
`cookieBlockState().fixable` OR logic can offer an ineffective action when unlocked global rejection coexists with an administrator `EXPIRE_POLICY` denial: `acceptCookies()` changes the global preference but cannot remove the policy exception, so OAuth remains unavailable. Hide the action unless every active block is user-removable; cover that combined state. [Task 1]
